purpose: Assess whether the remote-range row parity work can be extended into an executable compact-target model path without full download or disk cleanup.

alias_tsv_loader.source_open_behavior: expert_pack_open_alias_source uses fopen(path, rb) and optionally open(path, O_RDONLY|O_DIRECT). It does not support HTTP URLs or callbacks.
alias_tsv_loader.read_behavior: expert_pack_read_entry uses local FILE/pread/io_uring from source fd and entry offset/nbytes.

remote_range_parity.meaning: HTTP Range can fetch small real tensor slices for offline parity; it is not currently integrated into runtime expert source reads.

reason: The model loader still needs a coherent local GGUF for dense tensors, metadata, tokenizer, and all tensors used in graph construction.
The expert alias TSV runtime currently points only to local files; source_path is opened with fopen/open, so HTTP URLs are not valid runtime sources.
A sparse local GGUF with only sampled ranges would read zeros for missing ranges and would not pass correctness.

Aliasing compact candidate expert bytes into the current native model is not sufficient because expert nbytes/type must match the loaded tensor requests, and compact candidate types differ from the current native model.

possible_paths.notes: Delete the already-rejected local IQ2_S only with explicit approval, download exactly one priority candidate, then run strict load/correctness/token-rate/TTFT/16GB gates.

possible_paths.path: new HTTP range source in expert alias runtime
possible_paths.notes: Would need authenticated/redirect-capable HTTP range reader, cache policy counted under 16GB cgroup, retry/error handling, and correctness gates. Dense/model-loader tensors remain unresolved unless the whole GGUF is also represented by a remote/range-aware loader.

possible_paths.path: local sparse full-file materialization with on-demand range population
possible_paths.notes: Plain sparse holes read as zeros; correctness requires either prefetching all accessed ranges or a FUSE/userfaultfd-like backing layer.

decision.next_step: Current no-full-download path should stop at parity evidence. Real token-rate progress requires either explicit disk cleanup/full compact target download or a separate remote-backed loader/expert-source project with strict correctness gates.
